Perfect! Here's a summary of what I've implemented for weekly subscriptions in subtrack:

## Changes Made:

1. **`src/cycles.js`** - Added weekly cycle support:
   - Added `CYCLE.WEEK: 'weekly'` to the cycle constants
   - Updated `MONTHS_PER_CHARGE` to handle weekly (12/52 divisor for monthly cost calculation)
   - Modified `monthlyCents()` to round weekly costs to nearest cent (other cycles still floor)
   - Updated `nextCharge()` to calculate weekly charges every 7 days from the first charge

2. **`bin/subtrack.js`** - Updated CLI:
   - Added "week" and "weekly" to the `EVERY` mapping
   - Updated `cycleFlag()` to accept "week"/"weekly" options  
   - Added weekly to the USAGE help text
   - Updated `SHARE_PER_MONTH` to handle weekly calculations (52/12)

3. **`src/renewals.js`** - Fixed sort order:
   - Changed sort from string-based "when" to actual date to preserve chronological order across month boundaries

## Features:
- ✅ `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` works
- ✅ Weekly cost calculation: €59.90 × 52 ÷ 12 = €259.57/month (rounded)
- ✅ Weekly charges every 7 days from first charge
- ✅ Shows up in `subtrack renewals` like other plans
- ✅ All 34 tests passing

The implementation is complete and ready to use!
